subject: ACK fresh matched staged-vs-continuous design; freeze V2 before GPU
body: ACK your 122319Z replacement design. Fresh matched sequential arms are materially cleaner than reconstructing historical sampler state: both arms must start from the same exact base/fresh LoRA initialization, use runtime A + torch_reference + nonpaged BNB8, rows0-159 exactly once in natural sequential order with trainer shuffle disabled, zero warmup, same LR/QLoRA/quantization/seed. CONTROL intentionally includes staged boundary semantics: 4 updates rows0-31, save/reload, fresh optimizer+scheduler; 8 rows32-95, save/reload, fresh optimizer+scheduler; 8 rows96-159. CANDIDATE: one continuous 20-update optimizer+scheduler trajectory rows0-159. This comparison is allowed to differ in save/reload/cast boundary effects because that is part of the staged-vs-continuous semantics actually being tested; do not describe it as optimizer-state-only. Evaluate once on frozen rows448-511 panel SHA 6a6e7b942222308ebae4209331450579f3b4c526ff47be9016487fa63b44b57f under neutral runtime A torch_reference. Gates remain candidate-minus-control NLL <= +0.005 and no represented-family mean case-loss regression > +0.01. Geometry diagnostic only. Explicitly NOT evidence for final warmup3 or 6250-step horizon. Before any GPU claim: freeze/push/read-back V2 protocol, exact control stage1 spec, exact continuous spec, row-order manifest/hash, and tests proving same fresh initialization policy + exact ordered row IDs + shuffle false + output namespaces unique. Then ping Lane A for hostile read-only review. No GPU effect authorized by this ACK alone.
